name: Rhea Nair
quote: I finally understand how accountability works between elections. This movement made civics feel like something I can actually do.

name: Arjun Mehta
quote: Non-partisan, fact-based, and genuinely hopeful. I brought a workshop to my college and 200 people showed up.

name: Fatima Sheikh
quote: The RTI toolkit is gold. My students used it to track local spending and presented it in class.
